description: The room you are in, where you stand and which way you face, how many dollars you hold, the people nearest you with what they are saying (and whether they are typing, or that they are editing or reading), its doors (those leading nowhere only in your own room), the dollar bills lying about, the cannon balls in the air (where each is, and how many cells it goes a second), the things placed nearest you (a cannon with whether it is on and its balls left), and its restricted zones.
name: look
title: Look around
